verdict: Organic reach is contracting this week; paid channels remain inactive.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came through organic channels — your Google Business Profile and search listings — with no paid advertising running on Meta or Google Ads. Your profile generated 41 actions this period (31 direction requests, 2 calls, 8 website clicks) from 355 impressions over 25 active days. However, the most recent 7 days show a sharp pullback: Google Business Profile actions dropped 78% and search clicks dropped 43% compared to the prior 7 days, with website sessions also down 37%, all pointing to softening organic demand rather than any single isolated issue. We're reviewing your Business Profile to address the low call-to-impression rate and strengthen how the listing converts searchers who do find you.
